summary: Iteration 8 testing of 4 new features (saved schedules, master edit/delete, report filters, real dashboard stats) plus regression. Backend: 92/92 pytest tests pass (31 new tests in test_new_features.py covering schedules CRUD+sorting+validation, master PUT/DELETE for teachers/classes/subjects/students with persistence verification, Guru RBAC 403 on all master writes, dashboard/stats correctness vs /api/masters+/api/journals, report filter (class/subject/period) on rows, Excel export and print HTML). Frontend: Admin + Guru end-to-end flows all pass - real dashboard stats (4 kelas / 12 siswa / 0% bulan ini / 2 jurnal, changes when data changes), empty-state messages for jadwal hari ini & perlu perhatian, schedule add -> persists after nav-away and after full browser reload -> delete via confirm, master add/edit inline (name + class select for siswa)/delete via confirm with correct toasts, report filters reflected in report-meta-* and in downloaded Excel + print HTML (only 7A / Matematika / 2026-08 rows), Guru cannot see admin nav and can manage own schedule + save attendance. No 4xx/5xx API calls and no console errors observed during UI runs.

minor.issue: Silent truncation: to_list(200) on source docs (journals list to_list(100)). Large datasets will produce incomplete reports with no pagination/indication.

No cascade/guard: deleting a class or subject leaves students, attendance, grades, journals and schedules referencing the removed name (orphan data). Consider blocking delete when referenced or warning the user.
No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook expects lockout after 5 failed attempts) - unlimited password guesses allowed.
password_hash written with $setOnInsert only, so changing a seeded password in code never updates an existing account (playbook expects seed to update password when changed).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Tampilkan rekap' (primary button) performs exactly the same Excel download as 'Ekspor Excel' - the label promises an in-app recap view but no table/preview is rendered.
Mini bar chart is hardcoded static data ([84,96,90,100,88] labelled A-E) - contradicts the 'Statistik Nyata' requirement; should be derived from filtered report data or removed.
Copy says 'Lebih dari 3 kali alpa bulan ini' while backend counts students with count >= 3 (i.e. 3 or more). Wording/logic mismatch.

issues: Roster table columns clipped ('Status kehadira...') - requires horizontal scroll inside .table-wrap; consider a stacked/card layout on mobile
Periode uses native browser month picker (type=month) instead of an app-styled picker - inconsistent with the rest of the styled form controls

action_items: Make 'Tampilkan rekap' render an actual filtered recap table (or relabel it) and drive the preview mini-chart from real filtered data
Align the 'Perlu perhatian' copy with the >=3 alpa backend rule
Add pagination/limit handling for /api/reports/* and /api/journals to avoid silent truncation
Decide cascade/guard behaviour when deleting a class or subject that is still referenced
Optional hardening: brute-force lockout on login and seed_accounts password refresh on change
critical_code_review_comments: server.py report_rows() is called directly by export/print handlers - fine, but the shared to_list(200) caps make Excel/print silently incomplete for real school volumes.
Master edit/delete data-testids are index-based on the filtered list (master-row-edit-N); stable enough for tests but id-based testids would be more robust.

App.js is a single 307-line file with very long single-line JSX components (Dashboard/Reports/Master each on one line); splitting into src/components/* would greatly improve maintainability and reviewability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iteration-8 features work end to end (backend + UI). Run backend suite with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini already enables xdist loadscope; do not add -n). New coverage lives in tests/test_new_features.py. Use tests/cleanup_test_data.py after runs to purge TEST_/ZZ UI data. For UI dialogs (window.confirm) use `page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.ensure_future(d.accept()))` - a non-awaited d.accept() in page.once caused a click to hang. Remaining open items are cosmetic/product decisions listed in action_items, not blockers.
rca_of_the_issue: Two pre-existing test-file defects were fixed (not app code): test_real_accounts_reports.py read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from the process env only and failed at collection; backend_test.py::test_journal_rows relied on a journal created by another test class, which under pytest-xdist loadscope runs in a different worker with a different TAG, causing an order-dependent failure.
